peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (89.4): 5.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 360 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Context, not scored: resales in 16.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 410 m, Orchard MRT about 780 m; closer than 288 of 551 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 740 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 400 m), more than 212 of 551 similar developments (the same as 62); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 440 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 980 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (River Green, 34 new sales, about 440 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 450 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 640 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 670 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 760 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 840 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 910 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 312 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,424 new sales and 1,144 resales (2,568 purchases); new sales were 55.5% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,880 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,144 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 397 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,144 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,272 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.1%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
